title: Generate your best “hero shot” with Seedance 2.5 first, then refine that same…
content:
Generate your best “hero shot” with Seedance 2.5 first, then refine that same generation instead of restarting from scratch to maintain consistent style/character/direction.

Use Intelligent Edit Mode to refine a clip by selecting the exact frame to edit and masking only the region that needs changes so the rest of the scene remains untouched.

In Intelligent Edit Mode, choose up to 5 time points and edit up to 5 selected regions to make targeted fixes (e.g., adjust a face, change a color, replace a background) without affecting the rest of the video.

After the hero shot is finalized, use 3 Min Long Video Mode to extend the same visual direction into a longer sequence rather than generating separate disconnected clips.
